title: Function basics
summary: Trace a function return value and compare it with the requested result.
statement: Fix doubleValue so it returns twice the input. Predict the value of the return expression when the input is 3.

specification.output: Print twice the input value followed by a newline.
specification.constraints: Use a function returning an integer; keep the program as a single-file C++17 program.

checkpoints.question: What value does this function call return for the selected input?
